name: In-game help (part 2)
instructions: return JSON array [{"id": ..., "it": ...}] with one entry per id

units.id: help:shop with multiple ships|If you want to select a few similar ships from your fleet at once, double-click one of them. Other ships of the same model, with the same outfits as the one you selected will be added to your selection.|96|0
units.english: If you want to select a few similar ships from your fleet at once, double-click one of them. Other ships of the same model, with the same outfits as the one you selected will be added to your selection.

units.id: help:player info|The player info panel contains a wide variety of information about your pilot, including their net worth, combat rating, salary, and licenses.|99|0
units.english: The player info panel contains a wide variety of information about your pilot, including their net worth, combat rating, salary, and licenses.

units.id: help:player info|It also contains a list of all ships you currently own. Clicking on a ship and then going to the ship info tab, or double clicking on it, will bring up more information about that ship.|100|0
units.english: It also contains a list of all ships you currently own. Clicking on a ship and then going to the ship info tab, or double clicking on it, will bring up more information about that ship.

units.id: help:player info|Your pilot's logbook and current missions can be accessed by clicking on the buttons below the panel.|101|0
units.english: Your pilot's logbook and current missions can be accessed by clicking on the buttons below the panel.

units.id: help:player info|The player info panel can be brought up at any time by pressing <View player info>, including mid-flight. However, some functionalities of the panel can only be accessed while landed.|102|0
units.english: The player info panel can be brought up at any time by pressing <View player info>, including mid-flight. However, some functionalities of the panel can only be accessed while landed.

units.id: help:fleet management|You can click on the column headers to temporarily sort your fleet. To make this order permanent, press the "Save Order" button.|105|0
units.english: You can click on the column headers to temporarily sort your fleet. To make this order permanent, press the "Save Order" button.

units.id: help:fleet management|You can also park your ships by selecting them and pressing "Park", or by pressing "Park Local" or "Park All". Parked ships will not launch or follow you, and do not require any crew salaries. You cannot park or unpark ships mid-flight.|106|0
units.english: You can also park your ships by selecting them and pressing "Park", or by pressing "Park Local" or "Park All". Parked ships will not launch or follow you, and do not require any crew salaries. You cannot park or unpark ships mid-flight.

units.id: help:ship info|The ship info tab lets you view detailed information about ships in your fleet at any time. This includes any information you could see at a shipyard or outfitter, as well as the cargo and passengers distributed among each ship.|109|0
units.english: The ship info tab lets you view detailed information about ships in your fleet at any time. This includes any information you could see at a shipyard or outfitter, as well as the cargo and passengers distributed among each ship.

units.id: help:ship info|Ships can be renamed in this panel by clicking on the ship's name. While landed on a planet, you are able to change how guns and turrets are arranged by dragging the name of a weapon to another gun or turret location. While in flight, you are able to jettison individual pieces of cargo by clicking on the name of the cargo.|110|0
units.english: Ships can be renamed in this panel by clicking on the ship's name. While landed on a planet, you are able to change how guns and turrets are arranged by dragging the name of a weapon to another gun or turret location. While in flight, you are able to jettison individual pieces of cargo by clicking on the name of the cargo.

units.id: help:multiple ship controls|Once you're in space with multiple ships that you own, you can give orders to those escorts. Orders will be given to all selected escorts, or if no escorts are selected then all your escorts will receive the order. Escorts can be selected by either clicking on them in space, clicking the ship icon at the bottom left of the screen, or by clicking and dragging to select a group of escorts in space. The list of escort order keys can be found in the preferences panel.|113|0
units.english: Once you're in space with multiple ships that you own, you can give orders to those escorts. Orders will be given to all selected escorts, or if no escorts are selected then all your escorts will receive the order. Escorts can be selected by either clicking on them in space, clicking the ship icon at the bottom left of the screen, or by clicking and dragging to select a group of escorts in space. The list of escort order keys can be found in the preferences panel.

units.id: help:multiple ship controls|Escorts can also be ordered with the mouse. Right-clicking on an empty point in space will order escorts to fly to and hold position at that point, while right-clicking on a hostile ship will order your escorts to focus fire on it, and right-clicking on a friendly target will cause them to follow it.|114|0
units.english: Escorts can also be ordered with the mouse. Right-clicking on an empty point in space will order escorts to fly to and hold position at that point, while right-clicking on a hostile ship will order your escorts to focus fire on it, and right-clicking on a friendly target will cause them to follow it.

units.id: help:multiple ship controls|Escorts can be saved into control groups by pressing Control+number key. All selected escorts will then be bound to that number key, selecting the group when pressed.|115|0
units.english: Escorts can be saved into control groups by pressing Control+number key. All selected escorts will then be bound to that number key, selecting the group when pressed.

units.id: help:multiple ship controls|Ship group management can be done while flying around or while in the shipyard, outfitter, or player info panel.|116|0
units.english: Ship group management can be done while flying around or while in the shipyard, outfitter, or player info panel.

units.id: help:fleet asteroid mining|With an asteroid scanner and a fleet, you can direct your fleet to assist with mining operations and collect mined resources.|119|0
units.english: With an asteroid scanner and a fleet, you can direct your fleet to assist with mining operations and collect mined resources.

units.id: help:fleet asteroid mining|If your escort or fighter has no weapons but has cargo space, then it will chase after mined resources instead of mining.|120|0
units.english: If your escort or fighter has no weapons but has cargo space, then it will chase after mined resources instead of mining.

units.id: help:fleet asteroid mining shortcuts|Shortcuts for asteroid targeting:|123|0
units.english: Shortcuts for asteroid targeting:

units.english: <Select nearest asteroid> selects the nearest asteroid if you have an asteroid scanner.

units.id: help:fleet asteroid mining shortcuts|	<Fleet: Fight my target> will focus your fleet on mining a targeted asteroid.|125|0
units.english: <Fleet: Fight my target> will focus your fleet on mining a targeted asteroid.

units.id: help:fleet asteroid mining shortcuts|	<Fleet: Harvest flotsam> will toggle whether your fleet tries to pick up flotsam.|126|0
units.english: <Fleet: Harvest flotsam> will toggle whether your fleet tries to pick up flotsam.

units.id: help:fleet asteroid mining shortcuts|Alternate targeting:|128|0
units.english: Alternate targeting:

units.id: help:fleet asteroid mining shortcuts|	Left click - will target an asteroid without mining it.|129|0
units.english: Left click - will target an asteroid without mining it.

units.id: help:fleet asteroid mining shortcuts|	Right click - will focus your fleet to chase an asteroid and mine it.|130|0
units.english: Right click - will focus your fleet to chase an asteroid and mine it.

units.id: help:fleet harvest tutorial|You can order your escort to pick up discarded cargo or asteroid flotsam.|133|0
units.english: You can order your escort to pick up discarded cargo or asteroid flotsam.

units.id: help:fleet harvest tutorial|<Fleet: Harvest flotsam> will order your fleet to collect flotsam if they have free cargo.|135|0
units.english: <Fleet: Harvest flotsam> will order your fleet to collect flotsam if they have free cargo.

units.id: help:fleet harvest tutorial|Equip an asteroid scanner to learn more.|137|0
units.english: Equip an asteroid scanner to learn more.
